>>250536891
>However, I believe large scale de-industrialization is something that would require an authoritarian regime.

Correct; if and only if industrialization itself depended exclusively on the will of said authoritarian regime. protip: it doesn't; tech-civ depends on the self-directing forces of efficiency and 'the one best way' as masterfully described by Jacques Ellul. 

However, the 'abolishing' of the technological system as a whole would necessarily vitiate said authoritarian regime, and can be spurred by a small group of committed individuals; there is no need for a pseudo-democratic widespread agreement on the innate evils of tech-civ. ALL revolutions -good or bad, successful or not- were without exeption carried out by a tiny minority. Please see paragraphs 181 and 182 of ISAIF for more on this.
